A run from TypeScript source that no omo launcher started (a bare `bun test`, `bun <script>`) no longer migrates the account's shared gateway store past what released omo reads; it may still migrate an isolated agent dir (#14892). ([#14894](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14894))

### Fixed

- On Windows, a task or team member that runs as its own process is no longer refused at startup for CPU it never used: the startup CPU cap counted an unrelated long-running process whose exited parent had the same process id as the new child (#15098). The cap itself is unchanged. ([#15099](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/15099)) ([#15111](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/15111))

- Behaviour change: C1 control characters are refused in a typed thread reference (covered in `addressing.test.ts`; tab, line feed, vertical tab, form feed and carriage return still fold into a space and the other C0 controls and DEL are still refused, as before). ([#15025](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/15025)) ([#15111](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/15111))
- Ultrawork: `ulw` requests broad discovery before planning, a todo for each action, and one local commit per verified increment. ([#14871](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14871)) ([#15111](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/15111))
- The attached-engine loop example runs as written on example.com and example.org, whose pages no longer have an `h1`. ([#15083](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/15083))
- The omo SDK parity gate builds its merge-base comparison tree correctly on Windows: installed packages and paths on another drive are recognised with Windows path separators (#15052). No command or tool changes behaviour. ([#15055](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/15055))
- The attached-engine loop example sends its first `navigate` without a sync context, which the untouched Agent Window tab refuses (first reported and fixed in #14385 by @kristianvast). ([#15051](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/15051))
- `omo thread close` no longer fails with a TypeError on every call; it closes the thread and honours `--force` and `--graceful` (#14992). ([#15009](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/15009))
- The omo-senpi telemetry component check resolves its imports as the bundler does, so `loadOmoConfig` type-checks again, and the plugin bundles are regenerated from the current sources. ([#14940](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14940))
- `knip:check` passes on `dev` again: the unused `DEFAULT_OTLP_ENDPOINT` re-export and `telemetryDestinationHosts()` are gone from telemetry-core's destinations module. ([#14934](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14934), fixes [#14933](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/14933)) ([#14940](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14940))
- A task child whose open was still connecting when its parent released it no longer stays attached to the task host: the open is refused and its connection closed. ([#15069](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/15069)) ([#14936](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14936))
- A thread message sent with `omo thread send` (or through the thread SDK) to a session that is not running now wakes it, as a message from another session already did, instead of waiting until someone opens it. ([#15024](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/15024)) ([#14936](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14936))
- Several thread messages sent at once to an idle session no longer lose one or split into a second turn when they ra

### Fixed

- A project on TypeScript 7 or later gets TypeScript diagnostics after an edit through its own `tsc --lsp --stdio`, with nothing else installed. The compiler is taken from the edited file's project, so a monorepo package on TypeScript 7 is served by its own `tsc` even when the session starts at the repository root, while a sibling package on an older TypeScript keeps typescript-language-server. A diagnostics scan of a whole directory sends each file to its own project's server, so a scan at the repository root covers both kinds of package, and a package whose server is slow to start no longer holds up the others, nor does giving up on it stop a server another request is still waiting for. A file is judged by where it really lives: a symlink inside the session never lends it another project's compiler, and a `bin/tsc` belonging to another kind of project, or a `node_modules/.bin/tsc` left behind without its `typescript` package, never hides the TypeScript installed for the package. A `typescript` command you configured is never replaced. A project on an older TypeScript, or none, still resolves typescript-language-server exactly as before. ([#14656](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14656))

### Changed

- Ultrawork: verifying a UI deliverable asks for a play-through, a script that walks the product to several places or states and screenshots each, re-run after each feature. The default directive's existing verification sentences are rewritten in place and it is 6 bytes shorter. ([#14654](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14654))

**What senpi 2026.11.23 changes for you.**

- **Images on text-only models:** when a tool returns an image and the current model cannot read images, the `look_at` vision model now describes it and the description takes the image's place, so the model still gets the content.
- **macOS paths under `/home`:** a tool call naming a path under `/home` (an automount that may never answer) no longer stalls every file operation in the session; a mount that never answers is refused instead.
- **Self-hosted Anthropic-compatible proxies:** a custom `models.json` provider using `anthropic-messages` with an `sk-ant-oat...` key works again; the key is sent as a plain API key instead of failing before the first request.
- **Reopening right after an engine handover** no longer fails with `read ECONNRESET`.
- Claude, GLM and Kimi models are told to edit files with the session's file-editing tool directly, instead of from code cells. ([#14840](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14840))

**The memory footer no longer keeps showing "reflecting" after a reflection finishes.** A footer refresh that was still reading when the reflection ended could leave the spinner on screen until the next change; the line now always returns to the memory status once the reflection completes. (#14838) ([#14838](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14838))

**The memory status line no longer flickers through repeated identical updates.** Footer refreshes from a memory write, a settle and the reflection backlog land in whatever order their async work finishes, and several could publish the same line one after another; the line looked the same, but the number of updates depended on timing. An unchanged line is now published once, while every change and every clear still goes through. (#13046) ([#14825](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14825))

**A slow memory status refresh can no longer put an outdated line back on screen.** Each refresh now takes its place in line before it reads anything, and a line read earlier never replaces one read later; the uncommitted-changes marker is read only between memory writes, so it no longer flashes while a write is being committed. (#13046) ([#14825](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14825))

**omo now runs on senpi 2026.11.23.** The pinned engine moves from 2026.11.22 to 2026.11.23, which carries senpi#7392; the bundled plugin, the service-auth table and the EQ.omo goldens are regenerated for it. (#14822) ([#14822](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14822))

### Fixed

- A task child started as its own process no longer fails with `chain_not_held: timeout` when its engine takes longer than 10 s to boot, as on a cold Windows runner. The wait for the engine's first answer now ends only when the engine stops making CPU progress for 10 s, uses more than 120 s of CPU, or reaches a 10 minute outer limit; the 10 s limit now covers only the fallback-chain exchange itself. ([#14808](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14808), fixes [#13165](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/13165))
- The Senpi plugin build no longer fails every queued bundle when its shared Node minifier process is killed mid-build: a request the lost process did not answer is sent once to a fresh one, and a second loss still fails with that exit. ([#14767](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14767))
- The browser skill now uses omowright 0.3.2: the BrowserSkill daemon stays on its pinned release and no longer contacts a third-party update mirror or replaces its own binary, a command sent after the browser closed rejects instead of relaunching an unowned browser, the multiple-browsers and extension-outdated errors keep their coded error when the daemon sends unusual field values, and the Windows native-host installer allows a slower PowerShell cold start. ([#14760](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14760))

### Changed

- The `programming` skill's language gate now routes rendered web work (`.html`, `.css`, `.jsx`, `.tsx`, `.vue`, `.svelte`, `.astro`, or any task that ships a UI) to the `frontend` skill before the first line of UI code. It tells the agent to take the look from the frontend skill's references when there is no design direction (no named brand, reference, `DESIGN.md`, or existing styled UI to match), and to finish only after `visual-qa` passes on the rendered surface. ([#14604](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14604), fixes [#14602](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/14602))

### Fixed

- Memory sync: a sign-out now retires the trust pin of the account it signs out of, so `omo account show --account <id>` no longer answers `joined` once that sign-in's keys are gone. Plain `omo account forget` (the desktop's sign-out of a CLI-item session) used to retire nothing. It now reads the stored sign-in first to find its account. A stored sign-in that cannot be read is still deleted and its pin is left; one warning line is printed only after the delete succeeds. A forget that fails on a locked store reports only that error (#12308, #12384). ([#13642](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13642)) ([#14533](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14533))
- Memory sync: some sign-ins earned their pin before `omo sync` recorded their account. On a refused refresh, plain `forget`, `forget --device` and `adopt --replace`, omo now asks the service for that account, as `omo logout` already did, and retires the pin when the service names it. It asks only while a live pin exists and the access token has not expired; on a refused refresh, the token may still be valid in the 30 s before expiry, when the refresh runs. An expired token is never sent. A pin whose account stays unknown is kept, and omo prints one line naming `omo account retire-sync --account <id>` to clear it, because `omo account show` keeps answering `joined` for it (#12383, #13662). ([#13642](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13642)) ([#14533](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14533))

### Added

- `omo sync status` (and `--json`) shows this device's memory sync state: the signed-in account, whether this device has joined and whether its sync switch is on, the account's devices with their sync membership and last-seen time, pending join requests, and whether an engine is running on this machine. It writes no sync state, prints no key material, and each section reports its own failure instead of failing the command. ([#14437](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14437), fixes [#14435](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/14435)) ([#14533](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14533))

### Fixed

- The `/remote` close in the TUI follows `thread_close`'s close contract (#14234). A close refused because the thread has messages it has not read names `/remote close <session> --force` and lists those messages, or says the ids are unavailable on that device's engine. The picker then offers "Close anyway". A forced close lists the messages it dropped. The refusal's `details.reason` is the engine's own reason (`turn_active` or `work_pending`). ([#14246](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14246), fixes [#14245](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/14245)) ([#14248](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14248))
- Thread tools: a command for a thread whose session parked on another device after it was listed no longer fails `unsupported` with advice to update omo on that device. The device service answers such a command `route_unlisted` (its host no longer lists that session, so nothing was sent to it). `thread_close` now answers `closed: false, reason: "not_live"`, and the other thread tools answer `not_resumable`, as for a session that ended there. A create, or a reopen's session-file lookup, refused that way is `host_unavailable`, with a retry. ([#14237](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14237), fixes [#14233](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/14233)) ([#14248](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14248))
- The cold-wake session host unit (and every other unit or plist the cold-wake install writes) is now written 0644 under any umask. Under umask 077 it was written 0600, because a file's creation mode is masked by the umask; the mode is now set explicitly before the file is moved into place. ([#14249](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14249), fixes [#14247](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/14247)) ([#14248](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14248))
- A cold-wake unit or plist an earlier build already left 0600 is set back to 0644 the next time the install (or a refresh to a newer runtime) finds its content unchanged, with no reload or restart. A file this user cannot change the mode of (another owner's, or on a read-only filesystem) is left as it is and the install still succeeds. ([#14249](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14249)) ([#14248](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14248))

### Changed

- **`thread_close` no longer drops messages a thread has not read unless you ask it to.** Before, it always interrupted the session and silently dropped any messages queued behind its run. Now:
  - A busy thread with unread messages is refused `turn_active`. The refusal names those messages (`pending_deliveries`) and gives the `force` option.
  - `thread_close({ thread, force: true })` closes it anyway.
  - Every close result carries `dropped_deliveries`, the messages it handed back unread (an empty list when there were none).
  - An idle thread still closes without `force`, even when an interrupted run left messages stranded (#14169); those are listed too.
  - On a device whose engine cannot name its queued messages (older than code-yeongyu/senpi#7006), a default close never interrupts. It says the message ids are unavailable there, and `force: true` still closes it.
  - `omo remote close` takes `--force` and reports the dropped messages as well. ([#14242](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14242), fixes [#14234](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/14234)) ([#14248](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14248))

### Added

- The desktop can ask OmO which model each category and agent runs. A new read-only extension request, `omo.modelRouting.resolve`, answers the model every category (under its canonical name) and every task agent would spawn on, using the same resolvers a `task` call uses against the session's project config, model registry and sign-ins, and says whethe
